title: One Open Supply Enrollment per Patient — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** In the PAP Supply Replenishment Program a patient holds at most 1 supply enrollment that is not cancelled. A change of payer changes the schedule on the same enrollment rather than opening a second one. No enrollment is opened while another enrollment of the patient is pending enrollment, active or on hold.

## Condition for opening an enrollment

| What the patient's enrollment records show | Can a new enrollment be opened? |
|---|---|
| An enrollment of the patient that is pending enrollment | no |
| An enrollment of the patient that is active | no |
| An enrollment of the patient that is on hold | no |
| Only cancelled enrollments, or none at all | the rule above sets no bar |

The condition is read from the system's enrollment records for the same patient, before the enrollment is opened; what a caller says about an earlier enrollment does not replace that record.

## Basis Q&A

**A patient's primary coverage moved to a new payer. Does the patient get a second enrollment for the new payer?** No. The change of payer changes the schedule on the same enrollment; a second enrollment is not opened.

**A patient's earlier enrollment was cancelled. Does that enrollment count toward the limit of 1?** No. The limit counts enrollments that are not cancelled.

**A patient's enrollment is on hold. May a fresh enrollment be opened alongside it?** No. An enrollment on hold is one of the three statuses that bar opening another.
